scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Hey everybody!
Attention, attention!
Come and ride the wind
on a fascinating Ship!
Hurry, hurry!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
嘿，各位！
请注意，请注意！
快来搭乘这艘
迷人的船只乘风破浪吧！
快点，快点！

scripts.text: Byalan Island -> 150 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 前往拜兰岛 -> 150 泽尼

scripts.text: Alberta Marina  -> 500 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔至玛丽娜 -> 500 泽尼

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
150 Zeny!
Only 150 Zeny to ride!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
150 泽尼！
只要 150 泽尼就能搭乘！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
500 Zeny!
Only 500 Zeny to ride!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
500 泽尼！
只要 500 泽尼就能搭乘！

scripts.text:
[Bonne]
Greetings!
Izlude welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
您好！
欢迎来到依斯鲁得岛。

scripts.text:
[Bonne]
Izlude is the satellite city of Prontera, capital of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
依斯鲁得岛是卢恩·米德加兹王国首都普隆德拉的卫星城。

scripts.text:
[Bonne]
Izlude is key to our kingdom because of the Swordsman Association located here, as well as the fact that Izlude is in charge of protecting the Rune-Midgarts coastline.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
依斯鲁得岛对我们的王国至关重要，因为剑士公会就设在这里，而且依斯鲁得岛还负责守护卢恩·米德加兹的海岸线。

scripts.text:
[Bonne]
I know, this bridge might look weak and fragile, but it is actually state of the art, built with the most sophisticated technology.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
我知道，这座桥看起来可能很脆弱，但它其实是采用最尖端技术建造的。

scripts.text:
[Bonne]
No matter how strong storms may be, or how many people may stand on it, this bridge will NEEEEVER collapse.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
无论风暴多么猛烈，或者有多少人站在上面，这座桥也绝、对、不、会、塌、陷。

scripts.text:
[Bonne]
Please enjoy
your visit
here in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
祝您在
依斯鲁得岛
游玩愉快。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
Some people may think Izlude is just a satellite city of Prontera, and not really that important...
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
有些人可能觉得依斯鲁得岛只是普隆德拉的一个卫星城，并没有那么重要……

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
Though it is very beautiful, Byalan Island has a mysterious dungeon that extends deep under the sea.
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
虽然拜兰岛非常美丽，但那里有一个延伸至深海之下的神秘地下城。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
But Izlude is a beautiful town right next to the ocean, as well as beautiful Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
不过依斯鲁得岛是一个紧邻海洋的美丽城镇，拜兰岛也同样美丽。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
You'll have to board on a ship at the port to get to Byalan Island. There are dangerous dungeons on that island, so don't go snooping around just anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
你必须在港口搭乘船只才能前往拜兰岛。那座岛上有危险的地下城，所以千万不要到处乱逛。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
People who've actually been there have said that if you go deep enough, the dungeon actually descends underwater.
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
真正去过那里的人说，如果你走得足够深，地下城实际上会进入水下。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
Surprisingly, once you're underwater, you can breathe just like a fish. Maybe some kind of supernatural force is in effect.
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
令人惊讶的是，一旦进入水下，你就能像鱼一样呼吸。也许是某种超自然力量在起作用。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
Ah...
The people who've seen the underwater view say it is so fantastic that they've kept dreaming of it ever since.
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
啊……
见过水下景色的人说，那里的景象太奇幻了，以至于他们从此之后一直梦见那里。

scripts.text:
[Charfri]
But unfortunately, the monsters are too strong for ordinary people to merely go sightseeing there. Still, just once, I'd like to go down there...
scripts.translation:
[查弗里]
但不幸的是，那里的怪物太强大了，普通人无法仅仅为了观光而前往。不过，我也好想去那里看看啊……

scripts.text:
[Cuskoal]
The Arena here is THE place for capable young people from all over the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to challenge themselves and test their skills.
scripts.translation:
[库斯科尔]
这里的竞技场是来自整个卢恩·米德加兹王国、想要挑战自我并测试技能的有志青年的圣地。

scripts.text:
[Cuskoal]
The pubs in Prontera are always full of people from local areas and from out-of-town. It can get pretty busy.
scripts.translation:
[库斯科尔]
普隆德拉的酒馆里总是挤满了当地人和外地人，那里非常热闹。

scripts.text:
[Cuskoal]
You can battle with monsters of differing levels. So, the number of stages you survive will be a testament to your battle prowess.
scripts.translation:
[库斯科尔]
你可以与不同等级的怪物战斗。因此，你能生存多少个阶段，将证明你的战斗实力。

scripts.text:
[Cuskoal]
So, whaddya say?
scripts.translation:
[库斯科尔]
那么，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Cuskoal]
It's a pretty good place to stop by for general information and to listen to rumors.
scripts.translation:
[库斯科尔]
那里是个获取情报和打听传闻的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Cuskoal]
So if you listen carefully, you just might get lucky and learn some very useful information for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[库斯科尔]
所以如果你仔细听，说不定会运气好，学到一些非常有用的信息。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Mt. Mjornir, located north of Prontera, is a tough
and steep climb.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
位于普隆德拉北部的雷神之锤山，是一段艰难且陡峭的攀登之路。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Some monsters in the world have the unique ability to sense mystical energy, and can detect Magic spells before they are cast.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
世界上有些怪物拥有感知神秘能量的独特能力，它们能在魔法施放前就察觉到。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
There's a very delightful place where you can find every
type of Poring.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
有一个非常有趣的地方，你可以在那里找到各种各样的波利。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Aside from the dangers of the mountain itself, insanely vicious insects live there too. I mean, they'll just attack you for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
除了山本身存在的危险外，那里还住着极其凶猛的昆虫。我是说，它们会无缘无故地攻击你。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
If you ever want to visit somewhere past Mt. Mjolnir, then you prepare yourself for the challenge.  Or you could walk around it.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
如果你想去雷神之锤山以北的地方，那就做好迎接挑战的准备。或者你也可以绕道而行。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Golem of the desert is one of them. Don't underestimate it due to its sluggishness...
scripts.translation:
[德加]
沙漠中的巨石怪就是其中之一。不要因为它动作迟缓就小看它……

scripts.text:
[Dega]
If you try to cast magic near it, it will notice and saunter over to smash you. So you better watch out for Golem.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
如果你试图在它附近施放魔法，它就会察觉到并慢悠悠地走过来把你砸扁。所以你最好小心巨石怪。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
It's somewhere near the bridge connecting the forest and the desert, on the way to the city of Payon which is Southeast from here.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
它就在连接森林与沙漠的桥梁附近，就在前往东南方向斐扬城的路上。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
There are not only pink Porings but also Drops, which can be found at the desert, and the green Poporing.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
那里不仅有粉色的波利，还有可以在沙漠中发现的土波利，以及绿色的波波利。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
But be careful, before you realize it, you may come face to face with Ghostring, a deadly Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
但要小心，在你意识到之前，你可能会面对幽灵波利，那是一种像幽灵一样在空中漂浮的致命波利。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Well, of course, they are all very cute, but Ghostring is an EXCEPTION. It is very very dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
当然，它们都很可爱，但幽灵波利是个例外。它非常非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
If you are lucky enough, you might even bump into Angeling, the Poring with Angel wings.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
如果你足够幸运，甚至可能偶遇长着天使翅膀的波利——天使波利。

scripts.text: Ghostring?
scripts.translation: 幽灵波利？

scripts.text: Angeling?
scripts.translation: 天使波利？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Ghostring is a grayish Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost. Just like other ghosts, physical attacks can't do any damage to it.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
幽灵波利是一种灰色的波利，像幽灵一样在空中漂浮。和其他幽灵一样，物理攻击对它无效。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Those whose main attack methods are physical like Swordman and Archer might have to run for their lives when facing Ghostrings.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
像剑士和弓箭手这种以物理攻击为主的职业，在面对幽灵波利时恐怕只能落荒而逃了。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
But don't leave just yet~! There is great news for people with those jobs. Making a weapon of some elemental property is the key.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
不过先别急着走嘛~！对于这些职业的人来说，有个好消息。制作带有某种属性的武器就是关键。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
This way, even a Swordman or an Archer can inflict damage, the way Magic does, on Ghostrings.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
这样一来，即使是剑士或弓箭手，也能像使用魔法一样对幽灵波利造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Angelings are immune to Magic attacks. If people who can only attack with Magic face an Angeling, then it's time for
them to run.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
天使波利对魔法攻击免疫。如果只能用魔法攻击的人遇到了天使波利，那他们真的该逃命了。

scripts.text:
[Dega]
If you've got an extra knife or sword, you could give it a shot. But it will be very difficult alone, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[德加]
如果你手头有多余的小刀或剑，可以试一试。但如果是一个人战斗，会非常困难，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Dega]
Good Luck~
scripts.translation:
[德加]
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
I was thinking, even though the people of Izlude live so close to the ocean...
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
我在想，虽然依斯鲁得岛的人们离大海这么近……

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
There are other cultures that have completely developed by living off of the sea. Of course, I'm talking about Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
但也有其他文化是完全依靠海洋发展起来的。当然，我指的是樱花城。

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
I hear the cuisine there is really good! Although the idea of eating raw fish is new to me, I would love to go there, and try it just once!
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
我听说那里的料理非常棒！虽然吃生鱼的想法对我来说很新鲜，但我很想去那里尝试一次！

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
Don't you think Binoculars
are really COOL?! You can
see all sorts of places...!
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
你不觉得望远镜非常酷吗？！你可以看到各种各样的地方……！

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
Here in Izlude, we are responsible for maintaining peace not only on land but also at sea. That's why this city has a huge telescope.
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
在依斯鲁得岛，我们不仅要负责陆地的和平，还要负责海洋的和平。这就是为什么这座城市有一台巨大的望远镜。

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
This telescope constantly watches over the sea, so that we can prevent any serious trouble from happening. You know...
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
这台望远镜时刻注视着大海，这样我们就能防止任何严重的麻烦发生。你知道的……

scripts.text:
[Kylick]
An ounce of
prevention is worth
a pound of cure
after all, right?
scripts.translation:
[凯利克]
预防胜于治疗，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Red]
The only skill that's needed for a Swordman is ^FF2400Bash^000000! Bash, Bash and ONLY ^FF2400Bash^000000! No need to waste time and effort for smaller skills! Everything else is for cowards and wusses!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
剑士唯一需要的技能就是 ^FF2400连击^000000！连击，连击，只要 ^FF2400连击^000000！没必要在那些小技能上浪费时间和精力！其他的都是懦夫和弱者的行为！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
What are you talking about!? The ideal Swordman resolutely stands alone, surrounded by countless enemies and smashing them all with one awesome attack.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
你在说什么呢！？理想的剑士应该坚定地独自伫立，在无数敌人的包围中，用一次帅气的攻击将他们全部粉碎。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
^EE0000MAGNUM BREAK!^000000
That's right, Magnum Break
is the skill that does
the job right~!!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
^EE0000重击！^000000
没错，重击才是能把事情办妥的技能~！！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Well... Sometimes the explosive damage might accidentally hit some wandering monsters, and those guys end up coming after you, but that's a risk a Swordman should be willing to take!!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
好吧……有时候爆炸伤害可能会不小心击中一些游荡的怪物，导致那些家伙追过来，但那是剑士应该愿意承担的风险！！

scripts.text:
[Red]
That's exactly why you're dumb, you idiot! And what's this about the 'the ideal Swordman?' I still remember the last time you used Magnum Break...
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
正因为如此你才是个蠢货，你这个白痴！还有什么“理想的剑士”？我还记得你上次用重击的时候……

scripts.text:
[Red]
You ended up running away from all those monsters you hit with that stupid skill! Weakling! All those Porings around you got hit and they all tried to kill you.
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
你最后竟然被那个愚蠢技能击中的所有怪物追得落荒而逃！弱爆了！周围所有的波利都被击中了，它们全都想杀了你。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Hmpf. As I recall, you were running away too, apparently too busy to use your precious Bash. In any case, Magnum Break is THE skill for a Swordman~!!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
哼。我记得你也跑得飞快，显然忙得没空使用你那珍贵的连击。无论如何，重击才是剑士的终极技能~！！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Something simplistic like Bash
is just one of the little steps towards Magnum Break.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
像连击这种简单的技能，
只是通往连环重击的一小步而已。

scripts.text:
[Red]
Oh man~
Hey, I know you just
heard everything.
So what do you think?
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
噢天哪~
嘿，我知道你刚才
全都听到了。
那你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Red]
Which one do you think is better? The critical damage skill, ^FF2400Bash^000000, or the Splash damage skill, ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000?
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
你觉得哪一个更好？是暴击伤害技能 ^FF2400连击^000000，还是溅射伤害技能 ^EE0000连环重击^000000？

scripts.text: Bash
scripts.translation: 连击

scripts.text: Magnum Break
scripts.translation: 连环重击

scripts.text:
[Red]
Hahahaha!!! I knew you'd see things my way!! You ARE a great guy!! Undoubtedly, only ^FF2400Bash^000000 suits a Swordman. Please tell that to this BONEHEAD over here~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
哈哈哈哈！！！我就知道你会站在我这一边！！你真是个好人！！毫无疑问，只有 ^FF2400连击^000000 才适合剑士。请务必把这话告诉这个笨蛋~ 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Red]
Hmm, let me give you a bit of advice. After you achieve level 5 'Bash', the amount of SP consumed by the skill increases greatly, so watch out for your SP.
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
嗯，让我给你一点建议。当你达到“连击”5级之后，该技能消耗的SP会大幅增加，所以要注意你的SP。

scripts.text:
[Red]
Hahahaha!! See!? Someone who pursues a different job agrees with me~! You really are a great guy! Hahaha!! Undoubtedly, only ^FF2400Bash^000000 suits a Swordman. Please tell that to this NIMROD over here~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
哈哈哈哈！！看吧！？连追求不同职业的人都同意我的看法~！你真是个好人！哈哈哈！！毫无疑问，只有 ^FF2400连击^000000 才适合剑士。请务必把这话告诉这个蠢货~ 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Alright!! ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000 is the BEST!! Now you're talking~!! You know the stuff~ HaHaHa!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
没错！！^EE0000连环重击^000000 才是最棒的！！这才是明理的话~！！你很懂行嘛~ 哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
You wanna know some useful information? Okay, okay lemme tell ya! Magnum Break has Fire Property.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
你想知道一些有用的信息吗？好吧，好吧，我告诉你！连环重击具有火属性。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
So it won't be too effective against monsters with the Water property, but this is THE skill to use against Undead and Earth property monsters!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
所以它对水属性的怪物效果不会太好，但它是对付不死属性和地属性怪物的神技！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
And most importantly, look around before you use it. Otherwise you'll be in BIG trouble~
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
最重要的是，在使用之前先看看四周。否则你会惹上大麻烦的~

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Right?! ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000 is THE BEST!!! You know what you're talking about, eh? I don't know why this jerkface is being sooooo stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
对吧？！^EE0000连环重击^000000 才是最棒的！！！你很懂行嘛，嗯？我真不知道这个笨蛋为什么这么固执。

scripts.text:
[Red]
The only skill that's needed for a Swordman is ^FF2400Bash^000000! Bash, Bash and ONLY ^FF2400Bash^000000! No need to waste time and effort on smaller skills~~ Everything else is for cowards and wusses!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
剑士唯一需要的技能就是 ^FF2400连击^000000！连击，连击，只有 ^FF2400连击^000000！没必要在那些小技能上浪费时间和精力~~ 其他的一切都是给胆小鬼和软蛋准备的！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
What are you talking about!? The ideal Swordman resolutely stands alone, surrounded by countless foes, smashing them all with one awesome attack...
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
你在说什么啊！？理想的剑士应该坚定地屹立不倒，被无数敌人包围，然后用一次帅气的攻击将他们全部粉碎……

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
^EE0000MAGNUM BREAK!^000000
That's right, Magnum Break
is the perfect
Swordman skill.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
^EE0000连环重击！^000000
没错，连环重击
才是完美的
剑士技能。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Well...
Sometimes the explosion accidentally hits some monsters that are just wandering around.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
好吧……
有时候爆炸会不小心击中一些正在附近游荡的怪物。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Then they all end up coming after you, but that's a risk a true Swordman should be willing to take.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
然后它们最后都会冲向你，但那是真正的剑士应该愿意承担的风险。

scripts.text:
[Red]
That's exactly why you're dumb, you idiot! And what was that about the 'ideal Swordman?' You remember the last time you used Magnum Break?!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
这就是为什么你是个蠢货，你这个白痴！还有你刚才说的那个“理想的剑士”是怎么回事？你还记得你上次使用连环重击的时候吗？！

scripts.text:
[Red]
You had to run away from all those Porings hit by that stupid skill! You weakling! All those Porings that you hit tried to kill you!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
你不得不从那些被你那个愚蠢技能击中的波利群中逃跑！你这个弱者！所有被你击中的波利都想杀了你！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
Oh shut up. And those were Poporings. As I recall, you were running away too, apparently too busy to use your precious Bash.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
闭嘴吧。刚才那些是波波利。我记得你当时也在逃命，显然忙得根本没空用你那宝贝般的连击。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
In any case, Magnum Break is THE skill for a Swordman~!! Something simplistic like Bash is just one of those little steps towards Magnum Break.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
不管怎样，连环重击才是剑士的灵魂技能~！！像连击这种简单的招式，不过是通往连环重击的一小步罢了。

scripts.text:
[Red]
Oh man~
Hey, I know you
heard everything.
So what do you think?
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
噢，天哪~
嘿，我知道你
全都听到了。
那你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Red]
Which one do you think is better? The critical damage skill, ^FF2400Bash^000000, or the Splash damage skill, ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000?
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
你觉得哪一个更好？是暴击伤害技能 ^FF2400连击^000000，还是溅射伤害技能 ^EE0000连环重击^000000？

scripts.text: Bash
scripts.translation: 连击

scripts.text: Magnum Break
scripts.translation: 连环重击

scripts.text:
[Red]
Hahahaha!!! I knew you'd see things my way!! You ARE a great guy!! Without a doubt, only ^FF2400Bash^000000 suits a Swordman. Please tell that to FUNBOY over here!! Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
哈哈哈哈！！！我就知道你会认同我的观点！！你真是个好人！！毫无疑问，只有 ^FF2400连击^000000 才适合剑士。快去跟这边的“乐天派”说清楚！！哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Red]
Hmm, let me give you a bit of advice. After you achieve level 5 Bash, the amount of SP consumed by the skill increases greatly, so watch out for your SP.
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
唔，让我给你一点建议。当你把连击升到5级之后，该技能消耗的SP会大幅增加，所以要留意你的SP。

scripts.text:
[Red]
Hahahaha!!
See!? Someone who pursues a different job agrees with me~! You really are a great guy! Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
哈哈哈哈！！
看吧！？连不同职业的人都同意我的看法~！你真是个好人！哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Red]
Without a doubt, only ^FF2400Bash^000000 suits a Swordman. Please tell that to this MORON over here!! Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[雷德]
毫无疑问，只有 ^FF2400连击^000000 才适合剑士。快去跟这边的“笨蛋”说清楚！！哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
 Alright!! ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000 is the BEST!! Now you're talking~!! You know your stuff, kid. HaHaHa~!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
没错！！^EE0000连环重击^000000 才是最棒的！！这才是像样的话~！！小子，你挺懂行的嘛。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
You wanna know some useful information? Okay, okay lemme tell ya! The explosion from 'Magnum Break' has the Fire Property.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
想知道一些有用的情报吗？好吧，好吧，我告诉你！“连环重击”产生的爆炸具有火属性。

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
So it won't be very effective against Water property monsters, but this is THE skill to use against Undead and Earth property monsters.!
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
所以它对水属性怪物没什么效果，但它是对付不死属性和地属性怪物的神技！

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
And most importantly, look around before you use it. Otherwise you'll be in BIG trouble~
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
最重要的是，在使用之前先看看四周。否则你会惹上大麻烦的~

scripts.text:
[Cebalis]
I'm right, aren't I?! ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000 is THE BEST!!! You know what you're talking about, eh? I don't know why this LARDFACE is sooooo stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[塞巴利斯]
我说得没错吧？！^EE0000连环重击^000000 才是最棒的！！！你很懂行嘛，嗯？我真不知道这个“呆头呆脑”的家伙为什么这么固执。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
HeHeHeHe..HaHaHaHa 
Huh? Why am I so happy?
You wanna know?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿嘿嘿嘿..哈哈哈哈
嗯？我为什么这么开心？
你想知道吗？

scripts.text: Sure, why?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么？

scripts.text: Not really, I don't care.
scripts.translation: 不太想，我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Ah~~ There's not much for us to do these days. You see, Merchants buy items dropped by monsters. But you knew that, right?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊~~ 最近我们也没什么事可做。你看，商人会购买怪物掉落的物品。不过你早就知道了吧？

scripts.text: Of course
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Eh? Really?
scripts.translation: 诶？真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
HaHa~ In fact, that was actually part of our job. But there were more and more hunters who came to us in order to get paid and it became too much to handle.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈~ 其实，那原本也是我们工作的一部分。但后来找我们领钱的猎人越来越多，多到我们应付不过来。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We had to work overtime every day. Ah, it was a nightmare...! Anyway, the government eventually made a wise decision in creating the Registration System.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们每天都得加班。啊，简直是一场噩梦……！总之，政府最终做出了一个明智的决定，建立了登记制度。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Office of Prize Compensation only pays those who have the Registration. Of course, you'd have to be a merchant and stay in the same place all day long.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
奖金补偿办公室只向那些拥有登记证的人支付报酬。当然，你得是一名商人，并且整天待在同一个地方。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Office gives away the registration to any merchant who fulfills those requirements. So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
公会会向所有符合条件的商人发放注册证。所以现在，猎人们都会把货物卖给那些注册过的商人。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.  Not too many people come to us for that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
所以现在，猎人们都会把货物卖给那些注册过的商人。不再有太多人为了这个目的来找我们了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I mean we are still busy, but that's nothing compared to how it was before. People who have felt suffering know how to appreciate even the slightest comfort.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的意思是，我们现在依然很忙，但比起以前完全没法比。经历过苦难的人，哪怕是一点点慰藉都会倍感珍惜。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What?! What do you mean you didn't know?! Well, you know you can get items by killing monsters. If you bring and sell those to a merchant, you can make some money.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
什么？！你是说你不知道？！哎，你应该知道可以通过狩猎怪物来获取道具。如果你把那些东西带过来卖给商人，就能赚到钱。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
HaHa, in fact, that used to be part of our job. But there were more and more hunters who come in order to get paid, so it became too much to handle.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，其实，这曾经也是我们工作的一部分。但后来为了赚钱而来的猎人越来越多，我们实在应付不过来了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We had to work overtime every day. Ah, it was a nightmare...! Anyway, the government eventually made a wise decision in creating the Registration System.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们每天都得加班。啊，简直是一场噩梦……！总之，政府最终做出了一个明智的决定，建立了登记制度。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Office of Prize Compensation only pays those who have the Registration. Of course, you'd have to be a merchant and stay in the same place all day long.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
奖金补偿办公室只向那些拥有登记证的人支付报酬。当然，你得是一名商人，并且整天待在同一个地方。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The Office gives away the registration to any merchant who fulfills those requirements. So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
公会会向所有符合条件的商人发放注册证。所以现在，猎人们都会把货物卖给那些注册过的商人。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.  Not too many people come to us for that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
所以现在，猎人们都会把货物卖给那些注册过的商人。不再有太多人为了这个目的来找我们了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I mean we are still busy, but that's nothing compared to how it was before. People who have felt suffering know how to appreciate even the slightest comfort.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的意思是，我们现在依然很忙，但比起以前完全没法比。经历过苦难的人，哪怕是一点点慰藉都会倍感珍惜。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Okay Good Bye~~
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
好啦，再见~~

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Don't you think Strong VIT and training in a unique breathing method which enables quick HP recovery are the greatest advantages for a Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
你不觉得高VIT以及通过独特的呼吸法进行训练，从而实现快速HP回复，是剑士最大的优势吗？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
If you train your skills very hard, you can even see your HP recovering. The amount
recovered depends
vitality, or VIT.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
如果你刻苦训练技能，甚至能看到你的HP在恢复。恢复的量取决于体力，也就是VIT。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
So if you invest more of your stats in VIT, you'll recover more HP overall when resting.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
所以，如果你把更多的属性点投入到VIT上，休息时整体恢复的HP就会更多。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
But of course, it'd be good to have high Attack, wouldn't it? You can either acquire a good weapon or bring up your STR to support you Attack.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
不过当然，拥有高攻击力也是好事，不是吗？你可以选择获取一把好武器，或者提高STR来支撑你的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
You know you'll need some strength anyway to swing good weapons easily, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
反正你也需要一定的力量才能轻松挥动好武器。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Another important thing is how accurate you can hit your opponents. DEX is the key here. If you train DEX, then the gap between the MIN and MAX damage will also decrease.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
另一件重要的事是你的命中率。DEX是关键。如果你训练DEX，那么最小伤害和最大伤害之间的差距也会缩小。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Hm...
Are you bored by all this talk? Or do you want me to go on?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
唔...
你是听腻这些话了吗？还是想让我继续说下去？

scripts.text: Tell me more please.
scripts.translation: 请再多跟我讲讲。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Hmm...
In that case, I'll explain about the other attributes to you briefly. In order to attack and evade quickly, you've gotta pay attention to AGI.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
唔...
既然如此，那我就简单向你解释一下其他的属性吧。为了能够快速攻击和闪避，你必须关注AGI。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
In case you want to make more critical hits, it's a good idea to invest in LUK. INT also increases Max SP, which is needed to use various skills... But it's really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
如果你想增加暴击率，投入LUK是个好主意。INT也会增加Max SP，这是使用各种技能所必需的……不过，这完全取决于你自己。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Okay then,
train hard~~
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
好了，
努力训练吧~~

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Wanna
head back?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
想
回去了吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, I'm tired to death.
scripts.translation: 是的，我快累死了。

scripts.text: Nope, I love this place!
scripts.translation: 不，我喜欢这里！
